title: Basel III Endgame (US) Capital Impact Estimator
description: Estimates the risk-weighted asset (RWA) impact on a US bank under the March 19, 2026 federal banking agency NPR implementing Basel III Endgame reforms (consultation closed June 18, 2026). Models the Expanded Risk-Based Approach (ERA) credit risk standardized weights, operational risk Business Indicator Component (BIC), and off-balance sheet conversion factors. Does not include market risk (covered by T340 FRTB tool). Outputs AP2 mandate.

total_assets_bn.description: Total assets in USD billions (ERA applies to institutions ≥$100B)

cet1_ratio_pct.description: Current CET1 capital ratio as a percentage

gsib_surcharge_bps.description: G-SIB surcharge in basis points (0 if not a G-SIB)

obs_exposure_bn.description: Off-balance sheet exposures in USD billions (undrawn commitments, guarantees, LCs)

trading_book_bn.description: Trading book size in USD billions

gross_income_m.description: 3-year average gross income in USD millions (for BIC operational risk calculation)

current_rwa_bn.description: Current risk-weighted assets in USD billions under existing standardized approach

airb_usage.description: Whether the institution currently uses AIRB internal credit models

loan_portfolio.description: Loan portfolio breakdown by category as percentage of total loans

era_rwa_bn.description: Estimated total RWA under ERA in USD billions

rwa_change_bn.description: Change in RWA vs current approach in USD billions

cet1_impact_pct.description: CET1 ratio change in percentage points

distance_to_requirement_pct.description: Distance from ERA CET1 to minimum + conservation buffer + GSIB surcharge

op_risk_rwa_bn.description: Operational risk RWA under BIC in USD billions

impact_label.description: HIGH IMPACT | MODERATE IMPACT | LOWER IMPACT

mcp_tool_definition.name: basel_iii_endgame_capital_estimator
mcp_tool_definition.description: Estimate US Basel III Endgame capital impact under the March 2026 NPR. Returns ERA RWA delta, CET1 ratio impact, operational risk BIC charge, and buffer distance.

gross_income_m.description: 3yr average gross income in USD millions

regulatory_citations: Federal banking agencies NPR: Basel III Endgame (March 19, 2026)
